_meta.description: Authority-grounding bridge mined from notes/UK_OFFICIAL_DRAFTING_SOURCE_LEDGER.md. Maps a LawVM rule_id (a witness_rule_id constant) or a stable guidance-section family key to the official UK drafting-authority tier, the source reference, and the ledger's implementation status. This is the source-only authority layer (AGENTS.md 2.1), not the executable replay spec.

authority_tiers.1: official drafting guidance (OPC / TNA / Cabinet Office / Parliament)

key_kinds.witness_rule_id: rule_id is a real uk_legislation witness_rule_id constant
key_kinds.guidance_family: rule_id is a stable family key for a guidance section with no single named LawVM constant

_meta.source_note: ledger snapshot is allowed to lag executable code; status is faithful to the note, not re-verified here
